modelingNotes: Exact historical LA9-D09981 appears in the Telemecanique LC1-F catalog, physicalp.26/printed25, in the suppressor section alongside LA9-D09980. The bracket drawing is individually captioned LA9-D09981. This supports the historical spelling and suppressor-bracket scope without guessing from a neighboring order.

Current exact LA9D09981 manufacturer sheet p.1 identifies a TeSys F mounting accessory and lists LA4F compatibility. Historical and current scope are recorded separately; the current LA4F field alone does not disprove the source pairing with LA9-D09980. No successor equivalence or installed manufacturing revision is asserted.

Zero documented electrical terminals, no coil or switch functions and no fixed links. Host suppressor leads and contactor terminals belong to their own parts. Do not invent a mechanical attachment as an electrical connector port.

The exact photograph shows a mechanical arm/base assembly but does not establish a35mm DIN-rail mounting specification or an intentional protective bond. Conductive attachment/material and installed bonding remain unresolved; coverage is partial. No panel/rail/host continuity is claimed.
Use a documentation/BOM view. No electrical ratings or unsupported circuit geometry are assigned.
